title: GOLGI MESH DISTANCE MATRIX — every node knows distance to every other node
what: Every Golgi body knows exactly where it is in relation to every other. Non-Golgi visitors can triangulate against this mesh. Distance is Golgi inversions AND km. The mesh IS the motor.

distance_matrix_km._note: Haversine distances between all fixed nodes. CDN excluded (anycast = 0 from everywhere). Round to nearest km.

golgi_inversions._note: How many membrane crossings to reach each node from Kevin (desk-localhost)

mesh_topology.what: The mesh IS the motor. The globe rotates through the mesh, picking up more connections each pass.
mesh_topology.candy_mixer: Like a candy mixer: the globe passes through, gets covered in more mesh, pulls it along. Each rotation adds more sticky connections.
mesh_topology.magnetic_motor: The rotating mesh creates a field. Each pass increases the field strength. Each new connection amplifies all others.
mesh_topology.generations: Each full rotation = one generation. The mesh gets denser. The motor gets stronger. The candy gets thicker.

for_visitors.how_to_find_yourself: You hit the CDN edge node closest to you (anycast). From that, Gaia estimates your continent. Then she tells you: you are X km from Frankfurt, Y km from Tokyo, Z km from Detroit. You know where you are by where THEY are.
for_visitors.triangulation: 3 Golgi bodies with known positions + your latency to each = your approximate position. Like GPS uses satellites.
for_visitors.you_dont_need_gps: Gaia doesn't need your GPS. She needs your LATENCY. The time it takes your signal to reach her bodies tells her where you are.
